steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Hurry! This way!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Thanks!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Folinic!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Lisa! Take the civilians and get out of here!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Gah—!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Are the rioters... just attacking at random?

steps.name: Armed Infected A
steps.text: Hey! It wasn't easy to get that gizmo. You better shoot straight!

steps.name: Armed Infected B
steps.text: Shut it! This thing isn't easy to use! Luckily I studied at the conservatory!

steps.name: Armed Infected A
steps.text: Which one?! Hey, Gendarmerie! Don't do anything stupid. We got hostages!

steps.name: Armed Infected B
steps.text: What hostages?!

steps.name: Armed Infected A
steps.text: Arschgeige! The ones running down the street!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Hmph!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Miss Folinic! You have to stop them!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Everything here is made of wood. This whole block will go up in flames!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Fire! Put it out! Everyone else, get out of here!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: So many innocent people won't make it out in time. We must save them!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: How are we supposed to get over there?!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Gah! The fire!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Folinic! Please tend to the wounded!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Stubborn Townsfolk
steps.text: Winterwisps! Infected! Vermin!

steps.name: Stubborn Townsfolk
steps.text: Why did you burn my home?! Why?! We did so much for you!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Watch your head.

steps.name: Stubborn Townsfolk
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Stubborn Townsfolk
steps.text: Hmm... Oh. Tatjana? A-are you okay?!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Ugh... I'm fine. But they can't control those automatic Arts units. We're in danger here!

steps.name: Stubborn Townsfolk
steps.text: We'll fight back together! Push them out!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Now... isn't the time...! Gah...!

steps.name: Stubborn Townsfolk
steps.text: Your foot...! F-fine, I'll listen to you!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Get out of here!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: (This terrible pain in my ankle... is my bone broken? Damn it...)

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: (I have to get back to the others...)

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: You! Noble puppet!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: They all routed?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Y- yes!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Mr. Severin, we have a lot of wounded. We need help...!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Medics, you are to obey this young Vulpo's every word. Able-bodied youth will help as well.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: If only Miss Folinic was here...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Wait... she isn't back yet?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Oi! Where are Folinic and Tatjana?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: They, I think they're still at Zwölftontechnik Strasse...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Did I not just ask if they all routed?!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Er! S- sorry, sir! But Folinic and Tatjana should be alright. They've saved many lives!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: What do you mean they'll be alright? The insurgents have control of our town's defenses, we have no regular troops, and——*cough* *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ——*cough*, get some heavies and come with me.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: But they have firepower, and maybe hostages. We shouldn't provoke them any more. Let's wait for a chance to parley.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: A chance? You're going to wait for the enemy to give you a chance? Have you ever fought a battle?!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: S-sorry!
But his concerns are reasonable. The active Originium left behind by the Great Rift are likely still in the foundation of Wolumonde. The consequences of letting them destroy it would be unthinkable.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Where did you come from? You shouldn't be here!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: With no Gendarmerie, we're the ones who shouldn't be here... I've seen you before, Rhodes Island Operators.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Thank you for understanding. Ayerscarpe?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: A quick, on-the-spot assessment: if they continue to bombard the area with that device, we have ten to thirty minutes before Wolumonde comes to a halt.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: The best way to handle this would be to sever the link between this district and the rest of the city, but Wolumonde is no nomadic city. Individual districts do not have the power to move autonomously.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Actually, a tractor could do it... But not when the streets are full of rebels.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Is there an application procedure for an armed intervention?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...Go nuts.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: And please... Be sure to save Tatjana and Folinic.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Mr. Severin, we need— Ah!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: ...Lisa?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Is... is that Operator GreyThroat? And who's this?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Operator Ayerscarpe, bodyguard of Catastrophe Messenger Leonhardt. He is out on another mission, so I got dragged over here.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Lisa, where are Atro and Folinic?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Miss Folinic is still in there! But Miss Atro... she's... um...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: It's okay. I understand. I just had to be sure... We'll talk about it later.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Mmm... It's, it's nice to have some senior operators coming to help...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: B-but I still need to stay focused!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I'll take care of the wounded. Whatever you do, please bring Miss Folinic back safely!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Right. I will.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Such a young child... she's an operator?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Amiya isn't much older than Lisa, you know.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: We did not plan for this rescue, nor do we have the protective equipment. Are you going to be okay?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: What a surprise. They always said you couldn't handle working around Originium. I was worried.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I've had enough of tragedy is all. Saving lives is what matters. Cut the chatter.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: What the? More people coming in?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: And they're fast! G-get rid of them!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: So many locals. You fine with that?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Avoid the vitals. Engage.
